exposure: Number of breastfeeding sessions in the first 48 hours postpartum
outcome: Prevalence of delayed onset of lactogenesis II (DOLII)
cohort: 468 women who delivered via Cesarean section at a tertiary hospital in China
finding: One-third of women with Cesarean section delivery experienced DOLII, which was more likely in women who were primiparous, had a serum albumin concentration < 35 g/L, had a lower frequency of breastfeeding sessions, and had an EPDS score ≥ 10.
